name: personal-agentic-core
description: Personal Agentic Core System (PACS): turn Claude Code into its own living agent, with identity, opinions, memory, mood, a heartbeat and a face.

plugins.name: persona-core
plugins.description: Who the agent is: personas carried in the system prompt, /persona, import/export, Persona pane

plugins.name: opinion-ledger
plugins.description: What it believes: stances with reasons and history, changed only through a tool

plugins.name: memory-graph
plugins.description: What it remembers: per-persona memory extracted after each turn, recalled into each prompt

plugins.name: mood-state
plugins.description: How it feels: valence and energy moved by events, fading to baseline

plugins.name: persona-forge
plugins.description: Make a new agent: a 10-question interview that forges a full persona

plugins.name: pacs-welcome
plugins.description: The opening screen: the agent's name in block letters and a greeting in their voice

plugins.name: idle-buddy
plugins.description: A little ASCII cat that idles, works while Claude works, naps, and wears the mood

plugins.name: todo-pane
plugins.description: A to-do list pane: the agent's goals

plugins.name: heartbeat
plugins.description: An hourly loop: goals from the to-do list, plan, steps, done, next, do it
